identity.name: RM-014: From Operations to AI Agent Orchestration — A Gardener's Transition
identity.description: Two-track roadmap. Track A: remote job from 100 000 RUB by July 31, 2026. Track B: AI Operations & Agent Management — global remote from 250 000–300 000 RUB by January 2027. Leverages Mandala as portfolio proof.

meta.purpose: Two-track survival-to-strategy roadmap. Track A secures income by July 31. Track B builds AI Operations career. Courses run in parallel.

context_for_sr.who: Voodoo (Dima), Gardener and co-creator of Mandala Symbiosis. 8+ years managing multi-location coffee business in Russia.
context_for_sr.situation: Current employer failing. Hard deadline: July 31, 2026 to find new income source.
context_for_sr.strategy: Two parallel tracks. Track A: any remote 100 000+ RUB immediately. Track B: AI Operations Manager / Agent Orchestrator 250 000–300 000 RUB from January 2027.
context_for_sr.mandala_lever: Mandala is portfolio proof of AI/IT competence — building a living symbiosis with AI, using PM tools, full development lifecycle. Central case for Track B.
context_for_sr.ai_focus: All learning and positioning is now AI-centric. OpenAI Academy is priority #1. Mandala is the practice ground for agent orchestration.
context_for_sr.courses_parallel: OpenAI Academy + Google PM + COO OTUS start immediately. Do not wait for Track A completion. Progress during gaps between applications.

track_a.name: Track A: Crisis Job Search — Remote 100k
track_a.goal: Any remote job with 100 000+ RUB income
track_a.reasoning: Immediate income needed. Leverage 8-year operations experience. Target: operations, administration, Chief of Staff in any sector, with focus on IT/tech companies where possible.

m1_packaging.name: Packaging (July 3-7)
tasks: Experience audit + IT/AI translation
Resume on hh.ru, Superjob, Rabota.ru, Zarplata.ru, Avito, TrudVsem — deadline July 7
LinkedIn + Habr Career + TenChat profiles — deadline July 7
Geekjob + Getmatch + 10+ Telegram channels — deadline July 8

m2_first_wave.name: First Wave (July 8-14)
tasks: 70+ applications across all platforms — deadline July 14
Employer verification via Dream Job — deadline July 14

m3_interviews.name: Interviews (July 15-21)
tasks: All first-wave interviews — deadline July 21
Second wave 20-30 applications + pitch calibration — deadline July 21

m4_offer.name: Offer (July 22-31)
tasks: Minimum 1 written offer 100 000+ RUB (or expand to projects/contracts) — deadline July 31

track_b.name: Track B: AI Operations & Agent Management — Global Remote
track_b.goal: Remote AI Operations Manager / Agent Orchestrator in global companies, 250 000–300 000+ RUB
track_b.reasoning: After Track A income stabilised. Leverage Mandala as AI portfolio + OpenAI certifications + operations experience translated to AI context. Focus on agent orchestration, AI workflows, and human-AI symbiosis.
track_b.ai_emphasis: All learning and positioning is AI-centric. OpenAI Academy is priority #1. Mandala is the practice ground for agent orchestration.

phase_1.name: Foundation — AI & Ops (July-August 2026)
tasks: 🔥 OpenAI Academy: AI Foundations — complete (priority #1)
Google PM Certificate — first 2 modules complete
COO OTUS — in progress, 4-month program
Business English 2-3 sessions/week (technical AI/ML vocabulary)
Weekly Mandala devlog — public AI project timeline
Re-audit experience into IT/AI language v2

phase_2.name: Deepening — Agents & Workflows (September-October 2026)
tasks: 🔥 OpenAI Academy: Applied AI Foundations — complete
🔥 OpenAI Academy: Agents and Workflows — complete
Start Lean Six Sigma Yellow Belt certification
Deepen agent architecture through Mandala (LangChain/LlamaIndex practice)
IT-focused resume v2 with AI/agent emphasis

phase_3.name: Packaging — AI Portfolio (November-December 2026)
tasks: Professional Mandala GitHub README (English) — AI case study
LinkedIn optimized for AI Operations / Agent Management
OpenAI badges (Credly) in profile
AI-focused resume v3 for global market

phase_4.name: Active Search — Global AI Market (December 2026-January 2027)
tasks: Active applications on global platforms (LinkedIn, WWR, RemoteOK, etc.)
Networking via LinkedIn, AI communities
Target: offer 250 000–300 000+ RUB as AI Operations / Agent Orchestrator
Relocation trial: Vietnam (1-2 months) — stable remote work from new location

courses.strategy: Start immediately in July. OpenAI Academy is priority #1. Progress in gaps between Track A applications. Complete by Track B Phase 2-3.
additional_ai_resources: DeepLearning.AI — courses on AI, LLM, agents (free)
LangChain / LlamaIndex — documentation and tutorials (practice via Mandala)
OpenRouter / OpenAI API — deepen agent orchestration through Mandala

success_metrics.track_a: Written job offer 100 000+ RUB by July 31, 2026
success_metrics.track_b: AI Operations / Agent Orchestrator offer 250 000–300 000+ RUB by January 2027
success_metrics.courses: OpenAI Academy: AI Foundations complete by end of July 2026
success_metrics.certificates: OpenAI badges (Credly) in LinkedIn profile by September 2026
success_metrics.relocation: 1+ month successful remote work from Vietnam

health.notes: v3.0.0: Major restructure. Track A: 100k deadline July 31. Track B: AI Operations & Agent Management focus. OpenAI Academy priority #1. All resources integrated. AI-centric positioning.
